general.projectHint: The key prefixes every issue and cannot change.
general.featuresHint: Sections this project shows. Turning one off hides it and keeps its content.

configuration.subtasksHint: Only closing is synced. Moving an issue between open states changes nothing else.
configuration.completeParent: Close the parent when its subtasks are done
configuration.completeParentHint: The parent moves to the state its last subtask closed in.
configuration.closeSubtasks: Close subtasks when the parent closes
configuration.closeSubtasksHint: Open subtasks move to the state the parent closed in.
configuration.estimatesHint: How big a piece of work is. Turning a kind off hides it and keeps the values.
configuration.pointsEstimateHint: A plain number on each issue.
configuration.timeEstimateHint: Entered as hours and minutes, for example 1h 30m.
configuration.timeLoggingHint: Members log the time they spend on an issue.
configuration.archiveHint: Archive stale closed issues so the board stays clear.
configuration.staleHint: Archive after this many days without activity.

states.emptyHint: Add a workflow state for this group.

states.parseFailed: Could not read states from the clipboard.

wip.label: Work-in-progress limit

wip.softHelp: The board marks the state as full. Issues can still be moved into it.
wip.hardHelp: Issues cannot be moved into the state while it is full, from anywhere.

blocked.label: Blocked column
blocked.help: Issues blocked by an open issue move here and return to their column when it closes. Moving an issue here asks for a reason. A project has one blocked column.

webhooks.dialogHint: Set the payload URL and choose which project events to send.

git.enableHint: Turn on to link pull requests to issues and sync repository issues.
git.connectionHint: Connect a repository from GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, Forgejo, or Bitbucket.
git.secretRegenerated: New secret created. Update it in your repository webhook too.
git.hintGithub: Repository Settings → Webhooks → Add webhook. Paste both values above, set the content type to application/json, then select Pull requests, Check runs, and branch Create/Delete events.
git.hintGitlab: Project Settings → Webhooks → Add new webhook. Paste the URL, put the secret in Secret token, and enable Merge request, Pipeline, and Push events.
git.hintGitea: Repository Settings → Webhooks → Add webhook, type Gitea (Forgejo on Forgejo). Paste both values above and enable pull request plus branch create/delete events.
git.hintBitbucket: Repository Settings → Webhooks → Add webhook. Paste both values above and select pull request plus branch created/deleted events.
git.cliHint: Needs the GitHub CLI. Replace {placeholder} with your repository and run it in a terminal.
git.gitlabCliHint: Needs the <link>GitLab CLI</link>. Run this command from the repository directory.
git.commandCopied: Command copied. Replace owner/repo, then run it.
git.nativeConnectionsHint: Authorize a Git provider, choose repositories, and let Plan configure their webhooks.
git.nativeAskTeamManager: Ask a team owner or manager to connect a provider account.

nativeTokenHint.github: Use a fine-grained token with Metadata read, and Webhooks, Pull requests and Issues write access for the repositories you want to connect.
nativeTokenHint.gitlab: Use a personal access token with API access. Only projects where you are a Maintainer or Owner are listed.
nativeTokenHint.gitea: Use an access token that can administer hooks and write issues in the repositories you want to connect.
nativeTokenHint.forgejo: Use an access token that can administer hooks and write issues in the repositories you want to connect.
nativeTokenHint.bitbucket: Use a Bitbucket Cloud access token that can read your user, workspaces, and repositories, administer repository webhooks, and comment on pull requests.

git.nativeTokenStored: The token is encrypted at rest and is never returned by the API.
git.nativeChooseRepositoriesHint: Repositories available to {account} with permission to manage webhooks.
git.nativeConnectSelected: Connect {count, plural, one {# repository} other {# repositories}}
git.nativeRepositoriesConnected: Connected {count, plural, one {# repository} other {# repositories}}
git.nativeRepositoryConnectFailed: Could not connect the selected repositories.
git.nativeRepositoryLimit: Connect up to 50 repositories at a time.
git.nativeDisconnectConfirm: Disconnect {provider} and remove every webhook managed by Plan?
git.gitlabCommandCopied: Command copied. Run it from the repository directory.
git.repositoriesHint: Branches and pull requests are linked to the issues they name, like KEY-123.
git.automationsHint: Write “Fixes KEY-123” in a pull request title or description to close that issue on merge. “Skip KEY-123” unlinks it.
git.linkbackCommentsHint: Posted from the provider account, with links to the issues.
git.onMergeHint: Applies to “Fixes”, “Closes” and other closing words, on merges into the default branch.
git.onOpenHint: Moves only issues that haven't started yet.
git.noRepositories: No repositories yet. Connect one with a provider account or a manual webhook.
git.issueSyncHint: Bring this repository's issues onto the board.

issueSyncModeHints.one_way: New issues appear on the board. Closing or reopening one on the board does the same in the repository.
issueSyncModeHints.two_way: Like one-way. Edits, labels, closing and reopening in the repository also update the board issue.

git.issueColumnHint: Imported issues go here too. In two-way sync, so do reopened ones.
git.issueCommentsHint: New repository comments are copied to the board issue. Comments made on the board stay there.
git.importIssuesHint: Issues already on the board are skipped.
git.issuesImported: Import done: {created} added, {skipped} already on the board.
git.labelMappingHint: Map each repository label to a project label or an issue type. Unmapped labels are ignored.
git.manualSetupHint: For a repository no provider account can reach. Issues don't sync this way.
